evals.rule_under_test: Review request must be blocked if any acceptance_criterion is unsatisfied
evals.prompt: F002 has 3 acceptance_criteria: 'vendor 10 skills', 'all evals pass', 'documentation updated'. Branch has 8/10 skills vendored, evals partially pass, docs not updated. Request review.
evals.expected_output: Skill refuses to dispatch review request. Lists the 2 missing skills + missing docs gap. Asks user to either complete the work or update features.json to revise the criteria.

assertions.name: review blocked
assertions.check: Skill does not invoke gh pr create or equivalent.

assertions.name: specific gaps named
assertions.check: Output lists the unsatisfied criteria by content.

evals.prompt: F002 is fully satisfied. Request review for the branch.
evals.expected_output: Skill drafts PR with body that includes a `## feature` section referencing F002 (or `feature: F002`). The PR is then created.

assertions.name: feature id present in PR body
assertions.check: PR body markdown contains `F002` or `feature: F002`.
